name: Etched Parchment
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.

narrative.details:
Ah, while you were gone a parchment came for you, adventurer.

Read it when you have time. If I'm not mistaken, it came from the hunter trainer Jen'shan. She would have words with you when you're ready.
narrative.objectives: Read the Etched Parchment and speak to Jen'shan in the Valley of Trials.
narrative.offerRewardText:
When we finish speakin', you should talk to da rest of da citizens in da Valley. They ask you to do tings for them... tings that will test your skill and teach you some of da dangers of this land.

As you grow in experience and wisdom, you be needin' Jen'shan to show you better techniques and skills. Come back to Jen'shan often. I will let you know what I can teach you.
narrative.requestItemsText:
Ah, so you come at last. Good. Jen'shan be waitin' for you.

Many tink it be an easy path, but Jen'shan tell you dat not true. Mastering da beasts of Durotar and beyond take as much skill as masterin' the arcane arts or speakin' to our ancestors.

Firin' a bow or rifle may not be as dangerous to you as castin' a spell, but it sure be as dangerous to your enemy.

chain.subtitle: 4 quests from level 1 to 2, 290 XP in all.

quests.name: The New Horde
quests.objectiveText: Report to Gornek in the Den.

quests.name: Your Place in the World
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Gornek. You recall Kaltunk marking your map with his location and mentioning that Gornek resided in the Den, a building to the west.

quests.name: Cutting Teeth
quests.objectiveText: Kill 10 Mottled Boars then return to Gornek at the Den.

quests.name: Etched Parchment
quests.objectiveText: Read the Etched Parchment and speak to Jen'shan in the Valley of Trials.
